verdicts.verify_by: sed -n '83,93p' examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0/store.gno and sed -n '286,300p' examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0/listing.gno. Or append to the claim txtar: gnokey query vm/qrender --data gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0:api/v1/build, then ! stdout mylib
verdicts.tldr: The CTA promises a claimed package appears in Build and counts toward Top builders, but it does neither until it has 3 ranked stars
verdicts.details: A package cannot call Register, so Claim is its only path, and Claim leaves it unconfirmed (store.gno:86-89). index() returns at listing.gno:296 'if !l.Confirmed { return }' before ix.created, ix.updated, indexStars and updateBuilder, and buildShelves (shelves.gno:88-93) reads only toolbox.created, toolbox.updated and toolbox.stars. An owner who follows the snippet gets OK! and then finds the package on no Build shelf and absent from builders, with no hint that stars are needed. Fix: say in the CTA that a claimed package shows in Build and counts toward Top builders once it has 3 stars.
verdicts.evidence: Read at head: parts.html:144 'Listed packages appear in Build and count toward Top builders.'; store.gno:86-89 'a claimed listing is unconfirmed until it has 3 stars ... Until then a claimed package or service shows nowhere'; listing.gno:296-298 'if !l.Confirmed { return }' ahead of ix.created.Set and updateBuilder at 300-314; shelves.gno:90-92 build shelves read toolbox.created/updated/stars only.

verdicts.verify_by: Run P3 of b5-lines-reach-catalog-css-probe.mjs at 375px on the quiet-chain fixture. Expect visibleText "", children clock:none and moment:none, and the 8px dot drawn. See b5-lines-reach-catalog-pulse-phone.png.
verdicts.tldr: On a phone, a chain with no listing or star in 30 days shows the pulse as a lone green dot with no text under the intro
verdicts.details: newPulse (view.go:411-440) skips a figure whose 7d and 30d counts are both 0, but pages.html:11 draws the pulse whenever .Height is set, which is every live chain. Under 640px, store.css:145-148 hides .clock and .moment, so with no .figure the paragraph is left with only its ::before dot (store.css:112-123). The finder's screenshot shows that dot alone under the lead. Fix: draw the pulse on narrow screens only when .Items is non-empty, for example by guarding the paragraph with a class set when Items is empty and hiding it under the same media query.
verdicts.evidence: Read at head: pages.html:11 '{{ with .Pulse }}{{ if or .Height .Items .Moment }}'; view.go:426-428 'if n <= 0 { continue }'; store.css:145-148 '@media not (--md) { :is(.clock, .moment, .figure ~ .figure) { display: none; }'; store.css:112-114 '&::before { content: ""; display: inline-block;'. The finder's b5-lines-reach-catalog-pulse-phone.png at 375px shows the Explore heading, the intro and a single dot with no text. The finder's probe recorded visibleText "", clock:none, moment:none, dot 8x8px; it was not re-run here.

verdicts.verify_by: Add `"(Beta) Swap": "BS"` and `"#1 Wallet": "1W"` to TestInitials and run `go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/feature/store -run TestInitials`. Expect the failures to show "(S" and "#W"
verdicts.tldr: A multi-word title whose word starts with punctuation, like "(Beta) Swap", gets a generated icon reading "(S" instead of "BS"
verdicts.details: DeleteFunc at cover.go:81 keeps "(Beta)" and "Swap" because each contains a letter, so the default branch at 98-101 decodes the first rune of each word: '(' and 'S'. The single-word path removes punctuation through wordParts, and TestInitials pins that intent with "★ Swap": "SW", but no multi-word case starts a word with punctuation (store_test.go:356-373). Fix: decode from p[strings.IndexFunc(p, isAlnum):], which DeleteFunc guarantees is non-negative, and add "(Beta) Swap": "BS" to TestInitials.
verdicts.evidence: Read at head: cover.go:81 'parts := slices.DeleteFunc(strings.Fields(name), func(w string) bool { return strings.IndexFunc(w, isAlnum) < 0 })'; cover.go:98-101 'default: for _, p := range parts[:2] { r, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(p); out = append(out, unicode.ToUpper(r))'. Traced "(Beta) Swap": Fields gives ["(Beta)","Swap"], both kept, len 2, so it returns "(S". TestInitials cases (store_test.go:357-373) have no multi-word title with a leading-punctuation word. The test was not run, since this judge is read-only.
